description: Plan 30 days of posts for the business the account selects, for one platform (instagram, facebook, google_business, x or tiktok), and save them to its content calendar. posts_per_week is 1 to 7 (default 3); start_on (YYYY-MM-DD, today to 90 days ahead) defaults to tomorrow, Central time. OnHand writes each post from what the business approved, as draft_social_post does: its own services with their listed prices, the owner's FAQs, events the owner confirmed (placed up to two days before the event) and one post about the business; nothing repeats, so thin facts give a shorter plan. Writing a plan again replaces the platform's unedited posts in those 30 days and keeps the ones the owner edited. Returns the saved posts (post_id, platform, topic, planned_on, text, hashtags, image_idea, written_by, character_limit), can_edit and a message. Nothing is posted: the owner posts each one themselves. Ask the owner first. Owner, admin or operator; Live and Pro. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: draft_content_calendar
title: Plan my posting calendar
